text_en: Therefore we must pay greater attention to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away from it.
text_cn: 为此，我们必须更应注重所听的道理，免得为潮流所冲去。

text_en: For if the message declared through angels was valid, and every transgression or disobedience received a just penalty,
text_cn: 如果藉着天使所传示的话，发生了效力，凡违犯抗命的，都得了公平的报复；

text_en: how can we escape if we neglect so great a salvation? It was declared at first through the Lord, and it was attested to us by those who heard him,
text_cn: 那么，我们这些忽视这样伟大救恩的人，怎能逃脱惩罚呢？这救恩原是主亲自开始宣讲的，是那些听讲的人给我们证实的，

text_en: while God added his testimony by signs and wonders and various miracles, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, distributed according to his will.
text_cn: 又是天主以神迹、奇事和各种异能，以及照他的旨意所分配的圣神的奇恩，所一同证实的。

text_en: Now God did not subject the coming world, about which we are speaking, to angels.
text_cn: 的确，天主没有把我们所讨论的未来的世界，隶属于天使之下，

text_en: But someone has testified somewhere, “What are human beings that you are mindful of them, or mortals, that you care for them?
text_cn: 但有一个人在圣经某处曾证明说：“人算什么，你竟顾念他；人子算什么，你竟看顾他？

text_en: You have made them for a little while lower than the angels; you have crowned them with glory and honor,
text_cn: 你使他稍微逊于天使，赐给他尊崇和光荣当冠冕，【令他统治你手的造化，】

text_en: subjecting all things under their feet. ” Now in subjecting all things to them, God left nothing outside their control. As it is, we do not yet see everything in subjection to them,
text_cn: 将一切放在他的脚下。”“将一切放在他的脚下”一句，是说天主没有留下一样，不隶属于他权下的；但是现今我们还没有看见一切全隶属于他权下。

text_en: but we do see Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.
text_cn: 我们却看见了那位“稍微逊于天使”的耶稣，因所受的死亡之苦，接受了尊崇和光荣的冠冕；这原是出于天主的恩宠，使他为每个人尝到死味。

text_en: It was fitting that God, for whom and through whom all things exist, in bringing many children to glory, should make the pioneer of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
text_cn: 其实，那为万物的终向和万物根源的天主，既领导众子进入光荣，藉苦难来成全拯救众子的首领，也是适当的，

text_en: For the one who sanctifies and those who are sanctified all have one Father. For this reason Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters,
text_cn: 因为，祝圣者与被祝圣者都是出于一源；为这个原故，耶稣称他们为弟兄，并不以为耻，

text_en: saying, “I will proclaim your name to my brothers and sisters, in the midst of the congregation I will praise you. ”
text_cn: 说：“我要向我的弟兄，宣扬你的圣名；在集会中，我要赞扬你。”

text_en: And again, “I will put my trust in him. ” And again, “Here am I and the children whom God has given me. ”
text_cn: 又说：“我要依靠天主。”又说：“看，我和天主所赏给我的孩子。”

text_en: Since, therefore, the children share flesh and blood, he himself likewise shared the same things, so that through death he might destroy the one who has the power of death, that is, the devil,
text_cn: 那么，孩子既然都有同样的血肉，他照样也取了一样的血肉，为能藉着死亡，毁灭那握有死亡的权势者──魔鬼，

text_en: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by the fear of death.
text_cn: 并解救那些因死亡的恐怖，一生当奴隶的人。

text_en: For it is clear that he did not come to help angels, but the descendants of Abraham.
text_cn: 其实都知道，他没有援助天使，而援助了亚巴郎的后裔。

text_en: Therefore he had to become like his brothers and sisters in every respect, so that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in the service of God, to make a sacrifice of atonement for the sins of the people.
text_cn: 因此，他应当在各方面相似弟兄们，好能在关于天主的事上，成为一个仁慈和忠信的大司祭，以补赎人民的罪恶。

text_en: Because he himself was tested by what he suffered, he is able to help those who are being tested.
text_cn: 他既然亲自经过试探受了苦，也必能扶助受试探的人。
